subject: Texas AI Docket, Carousel No. 22, September 13th, 2026, What was the scanner taught on?
body:
What was the scanner taught on?

Carousel No. 22, September 13th, 2026

Did NOT meet the bar: 6.784 against 6.8. Read before posting.

This run did not merge, so the images below come from the run branch claude/daily-2026-09-13 rather than from main. They stop resolving if that branch is deleted.

What degraded

  • The run did not merge. No guards run exists on the branch, workflow_dispatch is refused with 403, and zero checks is never a state to merge in. Pull request no. 301 is open, ready and carries everything.
  • The deck shipped 0.016 under the 6.8 bar, at the five round cap, with no hard fail outstanding. Two judges refused on the threshold rather than on a fault.
  • The deck's declared value arc collapsed. Nine frames were planned at medians of 22, 46, 34, 30, 26, 18, 72, 26 and 28 and measure 11.1 to 41.1, with four of them within half a point of each other at the floor.
  • Frame 4's bridge from the panel review into the second paper was named by three reader judges in three consecutive rounds and was not repaired before the cap.
  • Frame 3 does not resolve at feed width. Four judges said so across the five rounds and three rebuilds did not fix it.
  • Seven of nine frames open on one type skeleton. Only frames 2 and 7 break it.
  • The INSTRUMENT visual register has now recurred for a third run. dedupe_check structurally cannot see it, because it compares topics, entities and artwork.
  • tx-2026-0120 was left unstamped. Its single dhs.gov source returned 403 to the checker, to a browser user agent and to the fetch tool alike.
  • The scanner's daily ceiling could not be read. The Supabase connector's tools are not enabled in this session, so the query had nowhere to run and nothing about the cap is known today.
  • Frame 7's own acceptance item is not met. The two rows it names differ by 19.1 L* where it asks for more than 40, because they sit inside the step rather than either side of it. The edge runs 78.0 L* across 6 CSS pixels, so the drawing does what the item intended and the item asks the wrong two rows.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it What was the scanner taught on?, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

What was the scanner taught on?

An expert panel with radiologists at Baylor College of Medicine and Texas Children's Hospital in Houston and at UT Southwestern in Dallas names off-label use of adult-trained AI models among its concerns for children. "Unlike adults, children go through continuous physiologic and anatomic changes that require age-specific models trained on representative developmental data."

A second paper, with MD Anderson in Houston and the UT Medical Branch in Galveston among its departments, put a number on the same move. Built on 198 brain metastasis patients, it met an independent 69 unchanged. The C-index read 0.615 in training and 0.574 outside it. Its authors call that "limited standalone discrimination". Both items are dated September 9th.

How much imaging AI in Texas is "off-label use of adult-trained AI models"?

#PediatricRadiology #TexasChildrens #UTMB

2. The first comment

The machine changed itself

  • panel_ready.py reads a value arc declared frame by frame inside the dossiers, not only as a summary paragraph, and reports a partial plan and a plan stated twice as their own findings
    Carousel 22 planned a median for all nine frames and wrote each one into that frame's own art.value_structure as `Frame median L* planned at 22`, which is the key SLIDE_DOSSIER_SPEC.md asks for the value structure in. No paragraph anywhere named the value arc, so arc_spans found nothing, planned_arc returned [], unreadable_plan returned [] because it only looks INSIDE an arc span, and the gate printed `(this storyboa
  • panel.py counts a scoring round as three judge cards it has not seen, instead of counting invocations of the combiner
    count_round appended one line per call and returned the length of the file, so every invocation was a round whatever it was called on. Carousel 22 ran five scoring rounds and the combiner was re-run once against a STALE integrity card while round 4's bookkeeping was being corrected. The counter read 6, the honest figure was 5, and the run had to write a prose correction into score.json beside the number. A counter le
  • Four upgrades were written into knowledge/carousel/UPGRADE_BACKLOG.md as proposals rather than built
    Each needs a file outside the upgrade lane. The one worth naming is that ten carousel gates have a --self-test CI never runs, measured rather than guessed, and panel_ready is one of them, so today's first upgrade is proved locally and by nothing else.

Each reverts on its own commit.

Notes

THE ONE ACTION THIS EMAIL NEEDS. Merge pull request no. 301 once a green guards run is on its head, and the deck's images move to main. This run could not merge because no CI run exists on the branch and none can be started from inside the session. The pull request opening started nothing, three pushes to a branch with the pull request already open started nothing, each moving the pull request's own head, and workflow_dispatch returns 403 Resource not accessible by integration. Yesterday's identical run got a pull_request run on guards.yml with the owner as its triggering actor, so the repository is fine and the credentials this session uses are what changed. Nothing in the repository can grant that. The record's worklist was cleared in full. 115 items were due of 127 on the two day leash with nothing rotten. reverify confirmed 79 unchanged against their own quotes and the remaining 48 were checked by hand, one primary source each, because they sit behind PDFs, Legistar's JSON API and JavaScript rendered agenda centers that the string check structurally can't read. No claim moved. Three decisions were admitted. An AJR expert panel review with radiologists at Texas Children's and UT Southwestern among its authors, stating that pediatric imaging is substantially underrepresented across AI in radiology. An MD Anderson and UT Medical Branch MRI radiomics model whose discrimination fell on an outside cohort. ERCOT's market notice telling providers which large loads sit provisionally in Batch Zero, every placement conditional. Three were held in the seed for one reason, which is that no source in window names a Texas county. Kodiak AI's Permian driverless deployment, Galaxy Digital's Batch Zero classifications and the Texas A&M AgriLife far ultraviolet poultry trial. A statewide flag used to mean nobody could tell is a claim about scope that nobody checked, so each is held with its reason and a later run that finds the place can promote it. One item was left unstamped on purpose. tx-2026-0120, the Homeland Security facial biometric assessment at the Progreso International Bridge, rests on a single dhs.gov page that returned 403 to the checker, to a browser user agent and to the fetch tool alike. Its movement line says what is therefore unconfirmed rather than what the fetcher did. The primary share reads 635 of 717 claims resting on a primary document, across 226 documents from 101 publishers. All three admissions cite primary documents only, so the share was not moved down by them. The instruments are all green by exit code and none has stopped. The water map draws 119 pins and the readout says 119 reservoirs. house_style_check went red at Phase 16 on the record's own prose rather than on the deck. Twelve sentences over the 30 word backstop, across the three admitted items, two re-verify movement lines and one claim text. Every one was this project's own writing rather than quoted source text, each was split at a clause in the ledger and never in docs/, and the site was rebuilt from it. Nothing in this run waited on a human. prompt_audit measured 1843 tool calls across both processes and found no call that put a dialog in front of anybody, with a debug log present, so this is a measurement rather than the absence of one. It is the reading taken last, immediately before this email.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck did NOT merge, so nothing here is on main and there is nothing to post. The links resolve against the run branch for as long as it exists.
